text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has once again rolled
around, and
this year, we'll focus on
training for the upcoming
Arima Kinen
and autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I give Бива Хаяхидэ her training
schedule,
she nods approvingly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is incredible. You managed to find
all this
information on the autumn Tenno
Sho?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: You even included data on the Arima Kinen and Brian's predicted times for the Kikuka Sho!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
How much time did you spend on this? It
must
have been so much work!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Then for the purpose of solidifying my
winning
equation, I graciously accept
your support.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'll work hard for both our sakes.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
